subject: Request: postponed integration sprint — ask for trial extension and promo credits
messages:
From: Laura Greene <laura@acmehealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood trial setup — blocked by staging API change

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this week. We started running the ingestion flows in our staging environment this morning and immediately hit a blocker: our internal API team shipped a schema change that broke our tokenization pipeline. Long story short, we need another sprint (2 weeks) to stabilize the staging work and re-run the Redwood end-to-end tests.

Because of the delay, our evaluation window will expire before we can complete the performance tests. Can Redwood extend our trial window and provide an additional promo credit bucket (we estimate ~150k–200k tokens) so we can finish the validation without the team having to re-provision paid capacity?

I attached a short failure log (api_failure_log.txt) and a screenshot of the error. If you need an engineer from our side on a quick call, Markus (cc'd) can join.

Apologies for the churn — this is on our side, but we'd like to keep the momentum.

Best,
Laura Greene
Lead Platform Engineer
Acme Health

On Wed, Oct 14, 2026 at 15:30 Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the time today — I uploaded the sample prompts and set up a staging endpoint. Happy to sync with your engineers tomorrow if helpful.
>
> - Aditya
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood trial setup — blocked by staging API change (promo credit request)

Folks — forwarding Laura's note. Quick summary: Acme Health hit a staging API change that will push their evaluation out ~2 weeks. They asked for an extension and ~200k promo token credits to finish perf/regression tests.

Proposed quick approach:
- Offer a 2-week trial extension (new end date: 2026-10-31).
- Add 150k promotional token credit initially; room to top up to 200k with manager sign-off.
- Require acceptance of trial_terms.pdf (simple T&Cs) and a DocuSign link for accounting visibility.

Why: large strategic healthcare prospect, integration timeline is clearly on their side; small promo keeps them moving and avoids losing momentum.

Ask: Neha — can you sign off on the commercial ask (150k starter)? Monica — can CS be looped for onboarding and a post-extension health check? Rishi — any objections on approving up to 200k if needed?

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: api_failure_log.txt
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood trial setup — blocked by staging API change (promo credit request)

Aditya / Neha —

I'm comfortable approving the following under the conditions below:

Approved:
- 150,000 promo token credits applied to Acme Health's trial balance immediately.
- Trial window extended to 2026-10-31 (2 weeks).

Conditions:
1) Add CS (Monica) as the primary contact for the extension and schedule a quick checkpoint within 3 business days of the extension start.
2) Send Acme the trial_terms.pdf and a DocuSign envelope; credits released upon acceptance of the simple terms.
3) If Acme requests >150k, escalate back to me with clear usage justification (they can request a top-up to 200k but need to justify).

Neha: please confirm you will handle the promo code flow in the portal and mark the deal record (ACME-2026-Q4-01). Monica: please schedule the onboarding checkpoint.

No objections from me — this is reasonable to keep the deal moving.

Thanks,
Rishi
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Laura Greene <laura@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Markus Holtz <markus.h@acmehealth.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial setup — blocked by staging API change — extension & credits confirmed

Hi Laura / Markus,

Thanks for the quick context and for sending the failure log. Per the internal approvals above, we can do the following to keep you moving:

1) Trial extension: we have extended your sandbox window to end on 2026-10-31.
2) Promo credits: 150,000 token promo credit has been reserved for Acme Health and will be applied once the trial_terms.pdf is signed via DocuSign (link below). If you need an additional top-up to 200k, let us know the justification and we'll review.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123456
Portal deal: https://app.redwood.com/deals/ACME-2026-Q4-01

Monica (CS) will reach out to schedule a 30-minute checkpoint early next week to help re-run the ingest and review perf metrics. If you'd like my engineer to join that call, I'm happy to arrange it.

Attachments: trial_terms.pdf (simple extension terms).

Appreciate your patience — we want to make this evaluation frictionless.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
